original_method: Resolve field ownership, then collect complete Type 27, referenced Type 28 and approved companion structures on the same SUT, reconcile device/probe/group identities and encoded speed/status values against the cooling topology before and after one authorized reboot.
manual_activity: The owner maps mixed fields, supplies the cooling-device and Type 28 probe topology, and approves reboot/recovery; automation then performs read-only cross-structure comparison.

Expected nominal-speed encoding/unit and unknown/unpopulated policy
Authoritative Type 28 probe handles and cooling-device-to-probe physical mapping
Any retained companion-structure matrices and protected evidence policy

Require reboot approval and stop on thermal anomaly, wrong target or failed recovery

Collect full Type 27, referenced Type 28 and approved companion structures
Normalize speed/status fields and resolve every probe handle/group
Compare same-target topology before/after approved reboot

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a normalized cooling-device inventory keyed by Type 27 handle/description, resolve its Type 28 probe and group membership, retain raw speed/status encodings and compare the complete approved topology across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds cross-structure probe linkage and cooling topology while rejecting filtered evidence, log clearing and active fan manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Cooling Device heading cannot reveal orphan probe handles, missing units, duplicate group members, incorrect status or speed sentinel semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS metadata does not prove live fan RPM or thermal response. This row validates declared topology only; active cooling performance needs separate non-substitutable coverage.

project_override_considerations: Optional devices, groups, unknown speeds or probe-handle exceptions must be tied to exact platform/BIOS identity; companion-field removal requires explicit governance.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and owner field-to-structure disposition
Approved Type 27 cooling and Type 28 probe topology plus any companion matrices
Complete pre/post raw Type 27 and referenced Type 28 records
Preserved logs, no fan/thermal write, reboot timeline, no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 27 item/command target cooling-device metadata, but the Procedure also requires Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other SMBIOS structures without defining whether they are companion coverage or copied criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict recording are complete. Execution is package-gated on structure mapping, cooling topology and reboot approval; later reviews can continue.

review_improvement: Preserves all source fields and adds Type 27-to-Type 28 handle resolution, cooling-group and speed/status invariants without changing thermal controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 27 describes relationships, not only values: a cooling device can appear present while referencing a nonexistent temperature-probe handle or being assigned to the wrong cooling group. Nominal Speed also has encoded unknown semantics and cannot be treated as a live RPM measurement. Complete Type 27/28 reconciliation validates declared topology, whereas copied chassis fields require separate owner mapping.
